lines: Let's take a tour of your back office — your command center for the whole business.
This is your home base. Everything you need to run and grow your Apex business lives right here.
First, your dashboard. It shows your progress at a glance — your rank, your volume, and your next goal.
Next, your team view. See everyone you've brought in and everyone they've brought in, all in one tree.
Your compensation section breaks down exactly how you earn and what you've earned so far.
Your commissions page shows every payment, clearly itemized, so you always know where you stand.
The products area is where you find everything you can offer, ready to share with a click.
And the training center — right here — holds this whole roadmap and every resource you'll need.
Spend a few minutes clicking around. The more familiar it feels, the faster you'll move.
That's your back office. Next, we'll help you choose your path. Let's keep going.
